summary: Implemented and live-verified a durable planner-to-implementer-to-tester-to-reviewer workflow. Signed identities are audience/workspace/task scoped and use canonical actor IDs; context is snapshot-bound and secret screened; persisted context/evidence is immutable; review is independent; conflicts require a signed human; publication records the human actor and timestamp without performing Git merge or push. The Portal exposes protected inspection and lifecycle controls using short-lived tokens held only in page memory.

files.change: Added HMAC-signed short-lived identities with canonical actor IDs and audience, workspace and optional task scope.
Added bounded context/evidence schemas, expanded secret path/content rejection, immutable digests and case-normalized independent-review checks.
Added snapshot provenance enforcement, verified reads, task-scoped lifecycle authorization, conflict workflow and durable human publication audit.
Added durable handoff/review storage, additive publication columns, immutable payload triggers and append-only audit triggers.
Added handoff, review and durable publication actor/timestamp schema fields.
Added deployable handoff tables, indexes and immutability/append-only triggers.
Added summary-only public metadata, authenticated full evidence and identity-derived lifecycle authorization.
Added protected evidence inspection and accept/review/resolve/publish controls using in-memory short-lived identities.
Added accessible handoff identity, evidence and action states.
Added a bounded CLI for generating short-lived signed worker or human identities without exposing the signing secret.
Added scope, tamper, secret-content, canonical actor and immutable storage assertions.
Added a reproducible live D1/API lifecycle smoke with cleanup.
Added live assertions for the handoff workflow and protected token input.
Added handoff token and live-smoke commands.

scopeExpansion.reason: Security and deployability required durable schema, migration, tests and operator token tooling in addition to the declared lib/app scope.
